definitions.short: Naphish , a son of Ishmael, and his posterity
definitions.full: H5305. Naphish נָפִישׁ proper name, masculine son of Ishmael, according to Gen 25:15 (P), = 1Chr 1:31 ( ᵐ5 Ναφες , ᵐ5 L Ναφεις ); = (Arab) tribe 5:19 ( ᵐ5 Ναφεισαδαιων , A ᵐ5 L Ναφισαιων ). נֶ֫פֶת see II. נוף .
